title: SWF: DefineButton2 drops grouped artwork and never emits filters/blend on button states
description: packages/swf/src/buttons.ts. DONE. (a) Both the char-ID pre-pass and state-collection loop now route through flattenDisplayObjects, so grouped artwork (type:'group') in a button keyframe expands into per-child ButtonRecords with the group offset applied (was: group skipped in pre-pass -> children got no char IDs -> vanished). (b) buildButtonRecord now sets ButtonHasFilterList (bit4) + ButtonHasBlendMode (bit5) and appends FILTERLIST (shared writeFilterList from filters.ts) then blend UI8 (SWF_BLEND_MODE) after the CXFORM per SWF8 spec order. colorEffect/alpha/visible captured for ALL state types (shape/bitmap/instance/text) via shared effectCXForm helper (task 1375). Exported writeFilterList from filters.ts. Tests: __tests__/buttons.test.ts tests 13-17 (group flatten -> 2 shapes + 2 records; blur filter -> bit4 + FILTERLIST id1; multiply blend -> bit5 + byte 3; filter+blend together; shape colorEffect -> non-identity CXFORM). Verify: full ordered build 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0; 'pnpm --filter @flash/swf test' 1484 passed (119 files); buttons.test.ts 17/17. Docs: docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md implementation notes. Confidence: confirmed.
